rows.main_subject: Construct and compare finite forms
rows.proposal: **Notice.** Keep the held sphere losing rings/segments. Describe finite representation; leave numerical analysis for later. Keep resolution, proportion and aesthetic value separate.
rows.carry_and_check: The same PointBody survives a changed mesh. Do not infer collider detail from visible tessellation.

rows.main_subject: Translate, rotate, scale and compose transforms
rows.proposal: **No new primary.** Preserve the cube and existing order comparisons. A different transform order can be mathematically correct; do not call it numerical error.
rows.carry_and_check: Named operations and a retained baseline, later reused in comparison.

rows.main_subject: Address, occupancy and loops
rows.proposal: **Prepare.** State valid index range and the difference between copying a value and sharing a container. Use the existing slots/cube rather than an early corruption show.
rows.carry_and_check: Later snapshots cannot silently alias. Invalid requests get an explicit response.

rows.main_subject: Colour by function and by action
rows.proposal: **Prepare.** Keep the same position-to-colour mapping and saved paint. A bounded posterisation variation may compare one continuous ramp with finite levels after the main lesson.
rows.carry_and_check: Same source values, changed output mapping. Graded colour is not probability or fuzzy inference.

rows.main_subject: A local rule becomes a global arrangement
rows.proposal: **One optional return.** Compare wrap and clamp at a visible seam with the same tile. Preserve the pattern lesson; keep the existing textureglitch effect as an effect.
rows.carry_and_check: Boundary policy is declared; no claim of actual memory corruption.

rows.main_subject: Rate, accumulation and a field lookup
rows.proposal: **Use what exists.** Riemann MID/LEFT/RIGHT and its held comparison already expose finite sampling. Introduce discrete simulation time with the point/trace; no integrator catalogue.
rows.carry_and_check: Numerical reference is named; prepare velocity and fixed steps for P1.

rows.main_subject: Force, impulse, mass and constrained motion
rows.proposal: **P1 primary.** One sphere throw, reference arc and stepped trace. Springs later prepare measured response. Keep stack overflow and catastrophic assemblages as valid consequences unless a contract actually fails.
rows.carry_and_check: Same initial state/time; predicted endpoint error; replay. No full engine settings experiment.

rows.main_subject: How updates seek a form or equilibrium
rows.proposal: **Return after P1.** Vary descent step on one fixed landscape; separate discretisation/overshoot from changed objective or constraint.
rows.carry_and_check: Preserve a loss trace; explain why one large update can miss a basin. Fixture before claims.

rows.main_subject: Phase, oscillation, interference and sound
rows.proposal: **P2 primary late in sequence.** One measured sphere response with a return path; existing ambient delay as audible companion. Gain before delay; do not turn every sine work into control theory.
rows.carry_and_check: Open/closed comparison and declared delayed sample. A moving output alone proves no feedback.

rows.main_subject: Samples, distributions, seeds and chance
rows.proposal: **P3 primary.** Upgrade the placed Monte Carlo dartboard's budget/seed comparison. Do not introduce three competing estimators.
rows.carry_and_check: Counts, seed, error and variability retained; no promise of monotonic convergence.

rows.main_subject: Correlated variation and sampling a field
rows.proposal: **Return.** Freeze field/seed; change sample spacing. Use existing point/field. Hold frequency fixed before discussing aliasing.
rows.carry_and_check: Sampling and source changes distinguishable; a coarse mesh is not new noise.

rows.main_subject: A function at every surface sample
rows.proposal: **P4 primary after repeating patterns.** One saved array, colour receiver, height receiver. Separately audit the RD previous-texture chain before claiming feedback simulation.
rows.carry_and_check: Source remains unchanged when interpretation switches; initialized state for any feedback loop.

rows.main_subject: Neighbourhood, old/next state, rule and history
rows.proposal: **Keep focus.** Current history lesson already earns snapshot and receiver distinctions. Later an optional old/next fault can reveal update order; it must not replace the Life lesson.
rows.carry_and_check: Saved history intact; synchronous rule tests. Continuous CA does not automatically teach fuzzy rules.

rows.main_subject: Recursion, scale and the stopping decision
rows.proposal: **Reflection/return only.** Reuse agreed recursion limits and finite depth. Do not reopen completed lessons merely to add “glitch.”
rows.carry_and_check: Base case and budget named; finite approximation is not a failed infinity.

rows.main_subject: Rewrite a sentence, interpret it as space
rows.proposal: **Return.** Keep the same generated word while changing the drawing interpreter. Deliberate bracket mismatch is a bounded optional parser exercise.
rows.carry_and_check: Grammar and interpreter distinguished; malformed input reported before geometry construction.

rows.main_subject: Search, selection, local constraints and generated worlds
rows.proposal: **No new primary.** Preserve seed and failed constraint records when comparing outputs. A layout can satisfy local rules and still have no route.
rows.carry_and_check: Reachability is checked separately from appearance; global success is not inferred from local validity.

rows.main_subject: Deformation, constraints, integration
rows.proposal: **P1 return.** Same cloth/spring state; compare a bounded step or iteration budget against a fixed reference configuration.
rows.carry_and_check: Residual stretch, finite state and replay recorded. Collision failure and instability named separately.

rows.main_subject: A sampled scalar field yields a surface
rows.proposal: **Approximation return.** Hold field/threshold fixed while changing grid resolution. Repair the threshold-opinion crossing interpolation first; use the actual mesh extractor for topology claims.
rows.carry_and_check: Descending/ascending crossing fixtures, mesh validity and cost; no precision claim from a capped bead display.

rows.main_subject: Union, intersection and difference
rows.proposal: **One optional edge case.** Reuse two cubes, then compare separation, touching and overlap. Document the operation's input assumptions.
rows.carry_and_check: Degenerate/non-manifold results require actual mesh checks, not a screenshot verdict.

rows.main_subject: Many local rules and collective behaviour
rows.proposal: **P2 return.** Observe one agent's sensed neighbours and response while varying one delay/gain. Preserve shared-state update discipline.
rows.carry_and_check: Local state, sensed state and command visible; instability of one configuration is not a claim about all swarms.

rows.main_subject: Data, categories, learning and evaluation
rows.proposal: **P5 small comparison.** Hand-authored overlapping distance categories → rules → weighted actuator output. Compare with the existing crisp categories; preserve the separate learning lesson.
rows.carry_and_check: Membership is not probability, and authored inference is not trained classification.

rows.main_subject: Relationships, reachability and structure
rows.proposal: **Reflective return.** Draw the already-built feedback loop as a graph and locate its delay. Show how a missing edge changes a route.
rows.carry_and_check: Connectivity alone says nothing about dynamical stability.

rows.main_subject: Formal limits, assumptions and proof
rows.proposal: **Distinguish.** Place numerical approximation, a program bug and a formal undecidability claim beside one another without making them interchangeable. No new solver artifact required.
rows.carry_and_check: Each claim names its evidence and domain. A crash does not demonstrate Gödel.

rows.main_subject: Compose, vary and question the chosen conditions
rows.proposal: **Compose verified returns.** Bring one measured controller or saved field into an existing experiment, retaining its reference. Treat QFEP as the project's authored research framing.
rows.carry_and_check: No performance/identity/universality claim follows merely from a QFEP label. Record what the composition hides.

rows.main_subject: Work after the limits; accountability and alternatives
rows.proposal: **P6 synthesis.** Two earlier tested copies, one intervention each: aliasing and decoder mismatch first. Baseline, consequence, recovery and retained result.
rows.carry_and_check: Fault must break a named invariant; valid unwanted consequence remains a different finding.
